  • Graphics: Intel Iris Plus Graphics 640 or equivalent

  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2.5 GHz (quad-core) or Apple M1/M2

  • Graphics: AMD Radeon Pro 5500M / Apple M1 GPU or equivalent
